description:
MultiDiverse is a new Erasmus Mundus joint master in multilingualism and cultural diversity run by the University of Konstanz, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki and Jagiellonian University in Kraków. The first scholarship round closed in May 2026 and the 2027-2029 call is expected to open on the programme website in early 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Joint degree conferred by all three consortium universities after study in Germany, Greece and Poland
  • Research-oriented curriculum combining linguistics, education, psychology and sociology
  • First semester in Konstanz, second in Thessaloniki, third in Kraków, with a thesis at the preferred university
  • Strong route into doctoral research or careers in education, media, language technology and integration policy

Who Should Apply

Applicants need a bachelor's degree in linguistics, education, psychology, sociology, speech and language therapy or a related discipline, plus C1-level English documentation. The first round asked for grades at least equivalent to the German grade 3.0.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarship for selected students: tuition coverage plus a monthly allowance (around 12 places per intake).

Deadline and How to Apply

Applications go through the official programme website. The 2026-2028 round closed on 15 May 2026, so keep an eye on the applications page for the 2027-2029 campaign. Key deadline information: 2027-2029 round not yet announced (the first round closed 15 May 2026) — check the official page.
